workflows.description: Canonical compositional workflow for representing non-arXiv scholarly article metadata, DOI/source URLs, ACM/DOI pages, and pasted bibliographic metadata without requiring a source-specific PDF, arXiv identifier, or file copy.
workflows.content: Represent a scholarly article from a DOI URL, source URL, pasted bibliographic text, or normalised metadata by extracting/coalescing metadata fields, creating or reusing a #V#scholarly_article concept through generic Vontology write tools, attaching text metadata, resolving authors/topics, attaching DOI and source identifiers, optionally linking a file copy, and reading back the materialised concept. Sparse URL-only inputs may create a provisional article representation named by DOI/source URI while preserving provenance. This workflow is the preferred execution surface for non-arXiv article representation requests before falling back to the generic tool-calling write path.

workflows.content: Resolve the represented person instance scope, create or reuse the exact public author identity selected by the parent scholarly workflow, resolve the authored-by predicate scope, add the canonical public authorship relation, and preserve source-bounded candidate identity when no cross-paper identifier is available.

workflows.description: Compatibility wrapper for scholarly paper/file-copy representation; delegates canonical article materialisation to the scholarly article metadata workflow.

workflows.description: Canonical arXiv child workflow for a supplied arXiv URL or identifier: normalise the source, fetch authoritative metadata, acquire or finalise the artefact, delegate representation, and fail closed on incomplete metadata. Select it directly only when the paper reference is already supplied independently of mail discovery. If the task asks to search, inspect, or read Gmail/email/messages and represent papers found there, choose the email-convergence parent so source provenance, all-message extraction, markers, and Gmail finality are preserved.
workflows.content: Represent an arXiv paper by extracting a canonical arXiv identifier, fetching authoritative arXiv metadata, deciding whether acquisition is required, invoking download_paper when needed, trying a direct PDF URL import as optional enrichment when primary acquisition is unavailable or fails, then delegating to the general scholarly-paper workflow with arXiv verification even when the PDF remains unavailable.

workflows.display_name: Source Neutral Paper Reference Ingestion Workflow
workflows.description: Canonical source-neutral entry workflow for scholarly references already supplied as arXiv IDs/URLs, DOI/source URLs, file-copy concepts, pasted metadata, or mixed sets. Select directly only when references are available independently of source discovery. If the task asks to search, inspect, or read Gmail/email/messages and represent papers found there, choose the email-convergence parent; it owns discovery, completeness, provenance, markers, and message finality and invokes this workflow as a child.
workflows.content: Normalise caller-supplied scholarly paper references into paper_reference_set.v1, preserve source/provenance context, optionally preview the list without mutation, then fan out each item to the represented item-ingestion workflow. A non-preview run completes only when at least one item succeeds; mixed results preserve item-level failures. Source-specific representation remains delegated to existing arXiv, scholarly metadata, and file-copy paper workflows.

workflows.display_name: Source Neutral Paper Reference Item Ingestion Workflow
workflows.description: Canonical per-item workflow that delegates a normalised paper_reference_set.v1 item to the represented arXiv, public-title resolution, organisation-scoped paper-under-preparation, scholarly metadata, or file-copy paper workflow, or returns a preview/typed failure without source-specific Python routing policy.
workflows.content: Route one normalised paper reference item by represented identity kind and paper type. arXiv items invoke #V#arxiv_paper_representation_workflow; DOI and source_uri items use public-title/metadata resolution; metadata explicitly typed #V#paper_under_preparation invokes #V#paper_under_preparation_representation_workflow; other metadata items invoke #V#public_paper_title_resolution_workflow, which resolves an exact public arXiv title before falling back to sufficient bibliographic identity; file_copy items invoke #V#scholarly_paper_representation_workflow; preview items return a non-mutating item summary; unsupported items fail closed with a typed paper_reference_error_code.

workflows.description: Resolves an otherwise unidentified scholarly-paper title against public arXiv records, accepts only one exact normalised title match, and delegates the verified public identity to the canonical arXiv representation workflow. If public lookup cannot establish one identity, it falls back to the metadata workflow, which succeeds only when the supplied bibliographic evidence is independently sufficient.
workflows.content: Prepare a public-title query, search arXiv, accept exactly one normalised title match (using supplied year or authors only to disambiguate exact-title duplicates), and represent the resolved public paper. Never invent an identifier or choose a merely similar title. Failed or ambiguous public resolution may use the bibliographic metadata fallback, but title alone is not sufficient for that fallback.
